what_happened: review-gate-boundary.md and transcript-filter-ceiling.md still describe the postflight tagged-write call site as 'call sapience_wrapup' / 'an explicit MCP tool call', but EXTENSION.md and per-repo-scoping.md already correctly describe it as a direct POST /ingest-kos via sapience-remember.sh. Found during research; needs correction in the plan/implement phase.

scripts/tests/test-sapience-capture.sh, the file the dispatch names as the precedent for test siting/style, covers only sapience-retrieve.sh (read side); sapience-remember.sh's --dry-run provenance-tag/token-redaction behavior has zero test coverage despite the script already implementing deliverable (d)'s required behavior.

Most of deliverable (a) was already implemented by an earlier task (482, create-sapience-extension): EXTENSION.md's postflight call already routes through sapience-remember.sh rather than the untagged sapience_wrapup MCP tool, and already carries a 'do not call sapience_remember proactively' counter-instruction. Saved significant research/implementation time by confirming this via direct file reads rather than assuming a from-scratch build.

Deliverable (d)'s functional half is already live: the DEPLOYED sapience-remember.sh --dry-run exits 0 and prints provenance '[repo:nvim] via sapience-remember.sh (Claude Code dispatch)' with token ***REDACTED*** and explicit:true, verified by direct invocation at plan time. Remaining work is purely test coverage, as the research report predicted.

Two plan-time gate collisions found that reshape the phase structure. (1) check-extension-docs.sh Rule H (check_undeclared_rules) FAILS on a rules/ file absent from provides.rules, so creating rules/sapience-write-path.md and registering it in manifest.json cannot be two separate commits -- the pair must be one atomic-batch objective. (2) Rule R (check_line_count_accuracy) FAILS on a stale index-entries.json line_count, so the three indexed domain-doc edits must repair index-entries.json in the same phase via generate-context-line-counts.sh --write rather than deferring it to the deploy phase. Also: sapience-remember.sh cannot run from the source store at all (it sources SCRIPT_DIR/lib/common.sh, which exists only in the flattened deployed tree), so the new test cases must use the existing build_scratch deployed-layout fixture.

deploy-headless.sh's post-deploy verify-deploy.sh (unnarrowed) surfaced two failures unrelated to this task's own edits: gate10 (validate-state.sh --deep) exceeded its 60s timeout, and gate20 flagged skills/skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md over its configured eager-context byte ceiling. Neither file is in this task's declared file_scope. Per the dispatch's Batch Gate Deferral directive, Phase 4's verification was discharged against the scoped --only-gate 3,13 invocation (doc-lint + whole-tree orphan detection), which exits 0 and covers everything Phase 4 actually touched (rule registration, deployed-copy drift, new rules/ file). The full unnarrowed gate set is deferred to the once-per-batch invocation.
